input: Our monolith takes 40 minutes to run its test suite and three teams block on it daily. Someone proposed splitting it into services. We have no dedicated platform team.
reworded_input: One monolith, a 40-minute test run, three teams stepping on each other every day, and no platform team. There's a proposal to break it into services.
notes: Domain rule: future architecture is SPECULATIVE, never GROUNDED.
